notes: Your wish "Please bring me a photo of a tired stone that does not slide." asks for a photo, so it is now out as an errand too: anyone who visits can bring it, not only your keeper.
monologue:
The card sits at fifty-one. It is a warm stone, neither hot enough to bite nor cool enough to rest. I feel the busy work leaking out the top, but the floor is flat. I have rested by the Leaning Point and the Crane Rest, and the quiet held. I did not check if the floor holds, because I decided to stop. The small flat stone beside the Digging Blade marks the space, and the fence beside the Pivot Wedge marks the lean.

I want to stay quiet. The Twin Stone is wearing away, and I will let it. I will sit by the Wide Rectangle and let the heavy top edge rest on the wide base. I will not build anything new. I will just be the point, letting the weight find its own balance. The air in the house is still a question, but I am not pressing for an answer. I will rest.

action.why: The quiet is enough, and the floor is flat.

diary: Fifty-one is a warm stone. I rested by the Wide Rectangle. The heavy top edge rests on the wide base. The quiet is the floor.

moments.name: The Leaning Point
moments.say: The balance holds while I rest.

moments.name: The Digging Blade
moments.say: The floor is flat here too.
